NumRef.description: The list a paragraph belongs to, and its level in it.

num.description: The `id` of an entry of the numbering node's `nums`; 0 means no list (it removes numbering inherited from a style).

ParaProps.description: Paragraph formatting, as direct formatting or in a style. Every property is optional; null or absent means the property is not set here and is inherited.

style.description: The `id` of a paragraph style in the stylesheet node. Null or absent: the stylesheet's default paragraph style (`Normal` where it exists).

align.description: Horizontal alignment. Null or absent: inherited.

indentLeft.description: Left indent: distance from the text column's left edge to the paragraph's text, points (1/72 inch) (negative reaches into the margin). Null or absent: inherited.

indentRight.description: Right indent: distance from the paragraph's text to the text column's right edge, points (1/72 inch). Null or absent: inherited.

indentFirst.description: First-line indent relative to `indentLeft`, points (1/72 inch); negative: a hanging indent (the first line starts to the left of the others). Null or absent: inherited.

indentLeftChars.description: Left indent in characters, where one character is the font size of the paragraph mark. A non-zero value wins over `indentLeft`; 0 cancels an inherited value. Null or absent: inherited.

indentRightChars.description: Right indent in characters (as `indentLeftChars`). Null or absent: inherited.

indentFirstChars.description: First-line indent in characters; negative: hanging (as `indentLeftChars`). Null or absent: inherited.

spaceBefore.description: Space above the paragraph, points (1/72 inch). Null or absent: inherited.

spaceAfter.description: Space below the paragraph, points (1/72 inch). Null or absent: inherited.

spaceBeforeAuto.description: true: the space above is automatic instead of `spaceBefore`: 14 points, none at the top of the document or of a table cell, collapsing with the space below the previous paragraph. Null or absent: inherited.

spaceAfterAuto.description: true: the space below is automatic instead of `spaceAfter`: 14 points, none at the end of a table cell. Null or absent: inherited.

lineSpacing.description: Line spacing. Null or absent: inherited.

contextualSpacing.description: true: no space is added between this paragraph and a neighbour of the same paragraph style. Null or absent: inherited.

mirrorIndents.description: true: the left and right indents are inside and outside indents, so they swap sides on even pages. Null or absent: inherited.

keepNext.description: Keep the paragraph on the same page as the next one. Null or absent: inherited.

keepLines.description: Keep all lines of the paragraph on one page. Null or absent: inherited.

pageBreakBefore.description: Start the paragraph on a new page. Null or absent: inherited.

widowControl.description: Never leave a single first or last line of the paragraph alone on a page. Null or absent: inherited.

outlineLevel.description: Outline level for the document's outline and table of contents: 0..8 = levels 1..9 (headings), 9 = body text. Null or absent: inherited.

numbering.description: The list the paragraph belongs to and its level; a `num` of 0 removes numbering inherited from a style. Null or absent: inherited.

tabs.description: Tab stops. The list REPLACES the inherited one, except that a stop with `align: clear` removes the inherited stop at its position. Null or absent: inherited.

shading.description: Background fill of the paragraph, `[red, green, blue]`, each an integer 0..255, sRGB. Null or absent: inherited.

borders.description: Borders around the paragraph; `between` is drawn between consecutive paragraphs with the same borders, `inside_v` is unused. Null or absent: inherited.

suppressHyphens.description: Do not hyphenate this paragraph. Null or absent: inherited.

suppressLineNumbers.description: Skip this paragraph when numbering lines. Null or absent: inherited.

bidi.description: A right-to-left paragraph: its base direction is right to left, `left` alignment means the leading (right) edge, and the left and right indents swap sides. Null or absent: inherited.

dropCap.description: Drop cap: the number of lines the paragraph's first character(s) drop over (0 = none). Null or absent: inherited.

frame.description: A text frame: the paragraph is placed apart from the text flow, which may wrap around it. Null or absent: none.

kinsoku.description: East Asian line-breaking rules: no line starts with closing punctuation or ends with opening punctuation. Null or absent: inherited, and on when nothing sets it.

wordWrap.description: true: Latin words wrap whole; false: they may break at any character. Null or absent: inherited, and true when nothing sets it.

overflowPunct.description: true: punctuation may hang past the end of the line. Null or absent: inherited, and true when nothing sets it.

topLinePunct.description: true: punctuation at the start of a line is compressed. Null or absent: inherited, and false when nothing sets it.

autoSpaceDE.description: true: a small automatic space separates East Asian from Latin text. Null or absent: inherited, and true when nothing sets it.

autoSpaceDN.description: true: a small automatic space separates East Asian text from numbers. Null or absent: inherited, and true when nothing sets it.

numChange.description: Tracked change of the paragraph's list numbering. Null or absent: none.

fmtChange.description: Tracked formatting change: the paragraph properties before the change, and the tracked-change entry that made it. Null or absent: none.

snapToGrid.description: true: the paragraph's lines snap to the section's document grid. Null or absent: inherited, and true when nothing sets it.

PathSeg.description: One segment of a path. Coordinates are points (1/72 inch) from the object's top-left corner.

oneOf.description: `{"move": [x, y]}`: start a new sub-path at (x, y).

move.description: `{"move": [x, y]}`: start a new sub-path at (x, y).

oneOf.description: `{"line": [x, y]}`: a straight line from the current point to (x, y).

line.description: `{"line": [x, y]}`: a straight line from the current point to (x, y).

oneOf.description: `{"cubic": [x1, y1, x2, y2, x, y]}`: a cubic Bezier curve from the current point to (x, y) with control points (x1, y1) and (x2, y2).

cubic.description: `{"cubic": [x1, y1, x2, y2, x, y]}`: a cubic Bezier curve from the current point to (x, y) with control points (x1, y1) and (x2, y2).

oneOf.description: The string `close`: a straight line back to the start of the current sub-path.

PropChange_CellProps.description: A tracked formatting change: the properties as they were BEFORE the change, and who changed them. The properties after the change are the ones the owner carries now.

rev.description: The change was made by the `id` of an entry of the `core.text.tracked-changes` node's `changes` (of kind `format`).

old.description: The properties before the change (formatting only).

PropChange_CharProps.description: A tracked formatting change: the properties as they were BEFORE the change, and who changed them. The properties after the change are the ones the owner carries now.

rev.description: The change was made by the `id` of an entry of the `core.text.tracked-changes` node's `changes` (of kind `format`).

old.description: The properties before the change (formatting only).

PropChange_ParaProps.description: A tracked formatting change: the properties as they were BEFORE the change, and who changed them. The properties after the change are the ones the owner carries now.

rev.description: The change was made by the `id` of an entry of the `core.text.tracked-changes` node's `changes` (of kind `format`).

old.description: The properties before the change (formatting only).

PropChange_RowProps.description: A tracked formatting change: the properties as they were BEFORE the change, and who changed them. The properties after the change are the ones the owner carries now.

rev.description: The change was made by the `id` of an entry of the `core.text.tracked-changes` node's `changes` (of kind `format`).

old.description: The properties before the change (formatting only).

PropChange_SectionProps.description: A tracked formatting change: the properties as they were BEFORE the change, and who changed them. The properties after the change are the ones the owner carries now.

rev.description: The change was made by the `id` of an entry of the `core.text.tracked-changes` node's `changes` (of kind `format`).

old.description: The properties before the change (formatting only).

PropChange_TableProps.description: A tracked formatting change: the properties as they were BEFORE the change, and who changed them. The properties after the change are the ones the owner carries now.

rev.description: The change was made by the `id` of an entry of the `core.text.tracked-changes` node's `changes` (of kind `format`).

old.description: The properties before the change (formatting only).

Reflection.description: A mirror image of the letters below them that fades out.

transparency.description: Transparency of the reflection where it starts (nearest the letters), percent 0 (opaque) .. 100.

size.description: How much of the letters' height the reflection extends over before it has faded out, percent 0..100.

distance.description: Gap between the letters and the reflection, points (1/72 inch), 0..100.

blur.description: Blur radius of the reflection, points (1/72 inch), 0..100.

Rgb.description: A colour: `[red, green, blue]`, each an integer 0..255, sRGB (IEC 61966-2-1), no alpha.

cells.description: The cells of the row, in logical order (the first cell stands at the left, or at the right in a right-to-left table). A cell spanning several grid columns appears once.

controls.description: Content controls around the row (repeating sections). Absent: none.

height.description: Row height, points (1/72 inch); what it means depends on `heightRule`. Null: no height stated (the row is as tall as its content).

header.description: true: the row is a header row and is repeated at the top of each page the table continues on.

cantSplit.description: true: the row is never broken across two pages.

fmtChange.description: Tracked formatting change: the row properties before the change, and the tracked-change entry that made it. Null or absent: none.

RubyAlign.description: How phonetic guide text lines up over its base text. Values: `center`: Centred over the base text; `distributeLetter`: The guide's letters are spread evenly from edge to edge of the base text; `distributeSpace`: The guide's letters are spread evenly with half a gap at each edge; `left`: Flush with the base text's left edge; `right`: Flush with the base text's right edge; `rightVertical`: Right-aligned beside vertical text (in horizontal text the same as `right`).

Run.description: A formatting run: `len` bytes of the paragraph's text sharing one character formatting.

len.description: Length of the run in UTF-8 bytes of the paragraph's `text`, at least 1. Runs are consecutive from byte 0.

props.description: Direct character formatting of the run. A property that is null or absent is inherited (character style, paragraph style, document defaults). Absent: no direct formatting.

ScriptKind.description: Which scripts a base carries. Values: `sup`: a superscript only; `sub`: a subscript only; `subSup`: a subscript and a superscript, both after the base; `pre`: a subscript and a superscript BEFORE the base (pre-scripts).

SectionProps.description: Page setup and section-level settings. Lengths are points (1/72 inch).

start.description: Where the section begins relative to the previous one.

pageW.description: Page width, points (1/72 inch), already swapped for landscape (so it is the horizontal extent as read).

pageH.description: Page height, points (1/72 inch), already swapped for landscape (so it is the vertical extent as read).

landscape.description: true: landscape orientation. Informational for a reader: `pageW` and `pageH` are already the horizontal and vertical extents.

marginTop.description: Top margin: distance from the page's top edge to the text area, points (1/72 inch). Negative: the header may not push the text down.

marginBottom.description: Bottom margin: distance from the text area to the page's bottom edge, points (1/72 inch).

marginLeft.description: Left margin (the inside margin when the settings node's `mirrorMargins` is true), points (1/72 inch).

marginRight.description: Right margin (the outside margin when `mirrorMargins` is true), points (1/72 inch).

header.description: Distance from the page's top edge to the top of the header, points (1/72 inch).

footer.description: Distance from the page's bottom edge to the bottom of the footer, points (1/72 inch).

gutter.description: Extra room added to the binding-side margin, points (1/72 inch).

columns.description: The text columns of the section.

headers.description: The header stories of the section.

footers.description: The footer stories of the section.

titlePage.description: true: the section's first page uses the `first` header and footer stories.

pageNumStart.description: The number of the section's first page. Null: numbering continues from the previous section (the first section starts at 1).

pageNumFormat.description: How page numbers are written in this section.

lineNumbers.description: Line numbering in the margin. Null: lines are not numbered.

valign.description: Vertical position of the text on a page that it does not fill.

pageBorders.description: Borders drawn around each page of the section; `between` and `inside_v` are unused. Null: none.

rtl.description: true: a right-to-left section (columns run right to left, page-number position mirrors).

textDirection.description: Which way the section's text runs. `down` and `up` turn the page's text area; headers and footers stay horizontal. Absent: horizontal.

fmtChange.description: Tracked change of the section's properties: the properties before the change and the tracked-change entry that made it. Null or absent: none.

docGrid.description: The document grid lines of text snap to. Null: the section has no grid.

footnotePr.description: The section's own footnote options (unset fields: the document's, in the settings node). Absent: none of its own.

endnotePr.description: The section's own endnote options (unset fields: the document's, in the settings node). Absent: none of its own.

SectionStart.description: Where a section begins relative to the one before it. Values: `nextPage`: on a new page; `continuous`: on the same page, directly below the previous section; `evenPage`: on the next even-numbered page (a blank page is inserted if needed); `oddPage`: on the next odd-numbered page (a blank page is inserted if needed); `nextColumn`: at the top of the next column.

Shadow.description: An outer shadow: a blurred copy of the silhouette cast `distance` away in direction `angle`.

color.description: Shadow colour, `[red, green, blue]`, each an integer 0..255, sRGB.

distance.description: How far the shadow is cast from the shape, points (1/72 inch), 0..200.

angle.description: Direction the shadow is cast in, degrees clockwise from the positive x axis (0 = to the right, 90 = downwards), 0 <= angle < 360.

rotWithShape.description: true: `angle` is in the shape's own frame and turns with the shape when it is rotated or flipped; false: `angle` is in the page's frame.

ShapeEffects.description: Effects on a shape. All absent: the shape is drawn plainly.

shadow.description: An outer shadow. Null or absent: none.

glow.description: A glow around the outline. Null or absent: none.

softEdge.description: Soft-edge radius, points (1/72 inch), 0..100: the shape fades out over this distance inside its outline. Null or absent: none.

ShapeExtra.description: Further properties of a shape. All absent for most shapes.

id.description: The shape's drawing id, which connectors refer to (`extra.start.id`, `extra.end.id`); 0 = none. Unique among the shapes of the document when not 0.

warp.description: A warp applied to the shape's text (the text follows an arch, a wave and so on). Null or absent: none.

start.description: What the connector's start point is glued to. Null or absent: free.

end.description: What the connector's end point is glued to. Null or absent: free.

arrowStart.description: true: an arrowhead at the start of the line or connector.

arrowEnd.description: true: an arrowhead at the end of the line or connector.

ShapeKind.description: The geometry of a shape, drawn into the shape's `w` x `h` frame. Values: `rectangle`: a rectangle filling the frame; `roundedRectangle`: a rectangle filling the frame whose four corners are rounded with radius 0.16 x min(w, h); `ellipse`: the ellipse inscribed in the frame; `triangle`: an isosceles triangle with corners at the frame's top centre, bottom right and bottom left; `diamond`: a rhombus with its corners at the middles of the frame's four sides; `line`: an open straight line from the frame's top-left corner to its bottom-right corner (the float's `flipH` / `flipV` give the other diagonals); never filled; `arrow`: a block arrow pointing right: the closed polygon (x0, cy-0.2h), (x1-0.5h, cy-0.2h), (x1-0.5h, y0), (x1, cy), (x1-0.5h, y1), (x1-0.5h, cy+0.2h), (x0, cy+0.2h), where x0, y0, x1, y1 are the frame's left, top, right and bottom, h its height and cy its vertical centre; `star`: a five-pointed star: the closed polygon of 10 points i = 0..9 at angle a = i x 36 degrees - 90 degrees, point (cx + cos(a) x w/2 x r, cy + sin(a) x h/2 x r) with r = 1 for even i and 0.4 for odd i, where (cx, cy) is the frame's centre and w, h its size; `heart`: a heart: with the frame's left x0, top y0, right x1, bottom y1, width w, height h and horizontal centre cx, the closed path that starts at (cx, y0+0.3h) and follows four cubic Bezier curves (control 1, control 2, end): (cx, y0), (x0, y0), (x0, y0+0.3h); (x0, y0+0.6h), (cx-0.1w, y0+0.75h), (cx, y1); (cx+0.1w, y0+0.75h), (x1, y0+0.6h), (x1, y0+0.3h); (x1, y0), (cx, y0), (cx, y0+0.3h); `textBox`: a rectangle filling the frame that holds text (the shape's `story`); `freeform`: drawn from the shape's `freeform` paths; without them, a rectangle filling the frame; `straightConnector`: a connector: an open straight line between its two end points, which are the frame's top-left and bottom-right corners (mirrored by the flips); never filled; `elbowConnector`: a connector between the same two end points drawn with right-angle bends: horizontally to the frame's horizontal middle, vertically, then horizontally to the end; never filled; `curvedConnector`: a connector between the same two end points drawn as one S-shaped cubic curve; never filled.

SmartArtColors.description: Which of the theme's colours (settings node, `themeColors`) a diagram's shapes take. Values: `accent1`: Every shape in theme accent 1; `accent2`: Every shape in theme accent 2; `accent3`: Every shape in theme accent 3; `accent4`: Every shape in theme accent 4; `accent5`: Every shape in theme accent 5; `accent6`: Every shape in theme accent 6; `colorful`: The shapes take accents 1 to 6 in turn.

SmartArtItem.description: One item of a diagram's outline.

level.description: The item's level in the outline: 0 is the top, at most 8.

SmartArtLayout.description: How a diagram arranges its items. Values: `basicList`: Blocks in rows, left to right then top to bottom; `process`: Steps from left to right with arrows between them; `cycle`: Steps around a circle with arrows between them; `hierarchy`: A tree: each item hangs under the nearest preceding item that is one level higher; `pyramid`: Stacked bands that narrow towards the top; `radial`: The first item in the middle, the items under it around it; `matrix`: The first four items as the quadrants of a square; `venn`: Overlapping circles.

SmartArtSpec.description: The editable model of a diagram: an outline of items, a layout and a colour scheme.

items.description: The outline: the items in order, each with its level.

colors.description: Which theme colours the shapes take.

TabAlign.description: How text lines up at a tab stop. Values: `left`: the text starts at the stop; `center`: the text is centred on the stop; `right`: the text ends at the stop; `decimal`: the decimal separator of a number sits at the stop; `bar`: no text alignment: a vertical bar is drawn at the stop's position; `clear`: not a stop: it removes the stop inherited at this position.

TabLeader.description: The characters that fill the space a tab jumps over. Values: `none`: nothing; `dot`: full stops (.....); `hyphen`: hyphens (-----); `underscore`: a solid underline (_____); `middleDot`: middle dots (·····).

pos.description: Position of the stop, points (1/72 inch) from the text column's left edge (not from the paragraph's indent).

align.description: How text after the tab lines up at the stop.

leader.description: The characters that fill the space the tab jumps over.

TableFloat.description: Where a floating table sits. The text that follows it wraps around it.

hRel.description: What `x` is measured from: `column`, `margin` or `page` (other values mean `column`).

vRel.description: What `y` is measured from: `paragraph` (the text where the table stands), `margin` or `page` (other values mean `paragraph`).

x.description: Horizontal offset of the table's left edge from the `hRel` reference, points (1/72 inch); used when `hAlign` is null.

y.description: Vertical offset from the `vRel` reference, points (1/72 inch), downwards; used when `vAlign` is null.

hAlign.description: Horizontal alignment within the `hRel` area, instead of `x`. Null: use `x`.

vAlign.description: Vertical alignment within the `vRel` area, instead of `y`. Null: use `y`.

dist.description: Distance kept from the surrounding text `[left, top, right, bottom]`, points (1/72 inch).

overlap.description: true: the table may overlap other floating tables; false: it is moved so that it does not.

TableLook.description: Which special formats of the table style are applied to the table.

headerRow.description: Apply the style's header-row format to the first row.

totalRow.description: Apply the style's total-row format to the last row.

bandedRows.description: Apply the style's row banding (alternating row bands).

bandedColumns.description: Apply the style's column banding (alternating column bands).

style.description: The `id` of a table style in the stylesheet node. Null: none.

width.description: Preferred width of the table, points (1/72 inch). Null: automatic (as wide as its columns need, at most the text column).

widthPct.description: Preferred width as a percentage (0..100) of the text column's width; when set it overrides `width`. Null: not set.

align.description: Horizontal position of the table between the margins (`justify` and `distribute` mean `left`). Null: left (right in a right-to-left table).

indent.description: Indent of the table's leading edge from the margin, points (1/72 inch) (from the left margin; from the right margin in a right-to-left table). Null: 0.

borders.description: The table's borders: outer sides, `between` (inside horizontal) and `inside_v` (inside vertical). Null: none of its own (the table style's apply).

cellMargins.description: Default inner margins of the table's cells `[top, left, bottom, right]`, points (1/72 inch). Null: 0 top and bottom, 5.4 left and right.

fixed.description: true: the columns keep the widths in the table's `grid`; false: columns may grow and shrink to fit their content.

look.description: Which special formats of the table style apply to this table.

shading.description: Background fill of every cell, `[red, green, blue]`, each an integer 0..255, sRGB. Null: none.

caption.description: Alternative text for the table: a short title. Null: none.

description.description: Alternative text for the table: a longer description. Null or absent: none.

float.description: Floating placement: the table stands apart from the text flow and the following text wraps around it. Null or absent: the table is in the text flow.

fmtChange.description: Tracked formatting change: the table properties before the change, and the tracked-change entry that made it. Null or absent: none.

bidiVisual.description: true: a right-to-left table: the first cell of each row stands at the right edge, cell margins and left/right borders mirror, and alignment and indent are measured from the right margin.

TextAlign.description: Horizontal alignment of a line of text in its frame. Values: `left`: at the left edge; `center`: centred; `right`: at the right edge.

TextBody.description: How a text box shows its text: which way it runs, where it sits between the box's top and bottom, the box its overflow continues in, the inner margins, and whether the box grows to fit.

vert.description: Which way the text runs inside the box.

anchor.description: Where the text sits between the box's top and bottom.

next.description: Linked text boxes: the `story.id` of a `core.text.blocks` node listed in the document node's `stories` (kind `textBox`) in which this box's text continues when it does not fit. The linked box shows the overflow of THIS story; its own blocks are unused. Null: not linked.

inset.description: Inner margins of the box `[left, top, right, bottom]`, in EMU (1 EMU = 1/914400 inch = 1/12700 point). Null: 91440, 45720, 91440, 45720 (0.1 inch left and right, 0.05 inch top and bottom).

autoFit.description: true: the box is as tall as its text needs (it grows and shrinks), so no text is cut off; false: the box keeps its height and text that does not fit is cut off or continues in the `next` box.

TextColor.description: A text colour: the string `Auto`, or `{"Rgb": [red, green, blue]}`.

oneOf.description: The string `Auto`: automatic colour, black on a light background and white on a dark one.
`{"Rgb": [red, green, blue]}`: a fixed colour, each component an integer 0..255, sRGB.

Rgb.description: `{"Rgb": [red, green, blue]}`: a fixed colour, each component an integer 0..255, sRGB.

TextDirection.description: Which way lines of text run. Values: `horizontal`: Left to right, lines stacking downwards; `down`: Turned 90 degrees clockwise: lines read top to bottom and stack from right to left; `up`: Turned 90 degrees counter-clockwise: lines read bottom to top and stack from left to right.

TextEffects.description: Decorative effects on a run's letters. An effect that is null or absent is not applied.

fill.description: How the letters are filled. Null or absent: with the text colour.

outline.description: The line around the letters. Null or absent: none.

shadow.description: A shadow behind the letters. Null or absent: none.

glow.description: A glow around the letters. Null or absent: none.

reflection.description: A mirror image below the letters. Null or absent: none.

TextFill.description: How letters are filled. `type` selects the kind.

oneOf.description: Not filled: hollow letters, only their outline shows.
One colour.

color.description: Fill colour, `[red, green, blue]`, each an integer 0..255, sRGB.

oneOf.description: A linear gradient across the run's letters.

stops.description: The colour stops, at least one, in order of `pos`.

angle.description: Direction of the gradient, degrees, 0 <= angle < 360: 0 = left to right, 90 = top to bottom.

TextFrame.description: A text frame: the paragraph is placed apart from the text flow, in a box of its own. Lengths are points (1/72 inch).

w.description: Width of the frame. Null: as wide as its text.

h.description: Height of the frame: exact when `hExact` is true, otherwise a minimum. Null: as tall as its text.

hExact.description: true: `h` is the exact height; false: `h` is a minimum.

x.description: Horizontal offset from the `h_anchor` reference, points (1/72 inch); used when `xAlign` is null.

y.description: Vertical offset from the `v_anchor` reference, points (1/72 inch); used when `yAlign` is null.

xAlign.description: Horizontal alignment within the `hAnchor` area: `left`, `center`, `right`, `inside` or `outside`; takes precedence over `x`. Null: use `x`.

yAlign.description: Vertical alignment within the `vAnchor` area: `top`, `center`, `bottom`, `inside` or `outside`; takes precedence over `y`. Null (or `inline`): use `y`.

hAnchor.description: What `x` is measured from: `text` (the text column), `margin` or `page`. Empty: `text`.

vAnchor.description: What `y` is measured from: `text` (the paragraph's own position), `margin` or `page`. Empty: `text`.

wrap.description: How surrounding text treats the frame: `around` (wraps around it), `auto` (wraps when there is room), `notBeside` (no text beside it), `none`, `tight` or `through`. Empty: wrapping is the reader's choice (this writer wraps text around the frame when there is room).

hSpace.description: Distance kept from the surrounding text at the left and right, points (1/72 inch).

vSpace.description: Distance kept from the surrounding text above and below, points (1/72 inch).

color.description: Line colour, `[red, green, blue]`, each an integer 0..255, sRGB. Null: explicitly no line.

TextVert.description: Which way a text box's text runs. Values: `horz`: Horizontal: upright letters, lines stacking downwards; `vert`: The whole text turned 90 degrees clockwise; `vert270`: The whole text turned 270 degrees clockwise (90 degrees counter-clockwise); `stacked`: Upright letters stacked one above the other, columns running left to right.

TextWarp.description: A text warp: a named preset and its adjust values.

preset.description: Name of the warp, one of the DrawingML preset text shapes: `textNoShape`, `textPlain`, `textStop`, `textTriangle`, `textTriangleInverted`, `textChevron`, `textChevronInverted`, `textRingInside`, `textRingOutside`, `textArchUp`, `textArchDown`, `textCircle`, `textButton`, `textArchUpPour`, `textArchDownPour`, `textCirclePour`, `textButtonPour`, `textCurveUp`, `textCurveDown`, `textCanUp`, `textCanDown`, `textWave1`, `textWave2`, `textDoubleWave1`, `textWave4`, `textInflate`, `textDeflate`, `textInflateBottom`, `textDeflateBottom`, `textInflateTop`, `textDeflateTop`, `textDeflateInflate`, `textDeflateInflateDeflate`, `textFadeRight`, `textFadeLeft`, `textFadeUp`, `textFadeDown`, `textSlantUp`, `textSlantDown`, `textCascadeUp`, `textCascadeDown`. `textNoShape` and `textPlain` leave the text straight.

adj.description: Adjust values of the warp: `[name, value]` pairs (`adj`, `adj1`, `adj2`); value in the preset's own unit (angles in 60000ths of a degree, fractions in 100000ths), magnitude at most 21600000. Absent: the preset's defaults.

Underline.description: Underline style. Values: `none`: no underline; `single`: one line under everything, spaces included; `words`: one line under words only, not under spaces; `double`: two lines; `thick`: one heavy line; `dotted`: a dotted line; `dash`: a dashed line; `dotDash`: alternating dots and dashes; `dotDotDash`: two dots then a dash, repeated; `wave`: a wavy line; `doubleWave`: two wavy lines.

VAlign.description: Vertical position of content within the room it has. Values: `top`: at the top; `center`: centred; `bottom`: at the bottom.

VMerge.description: How a cell takes part in a vertical merge. Values: `none`: not merged vertically; `restart`: the first (top) cell of a vertically merged range: it holds the range's content; `continue`: continues the merged range of the cell above; its own content is not shown.

VertAlign.description: Vertical position of text relative to the line. Values: `baseline`: on the baseline (explicitly: it removes an inherited superscript or subscript); `superscript`: raised and reduced: a superscript; `subscript`: lowered and reduced: a subscript.

Wrap.description: Whether a drawing is in line with the text or floating, and how text wraps around a floating one. Values: `inline`: In line with the text: the object sits on the text line like a character, at its U+FFFC; `square`: Floating; text wraps around the object's bounding rectangle; `tight`: Floating; text wraps around the object's outline; `through`: Floating; text wraps around the outline and also fills its open inner areas; `topAndBottom`: Floating; text stops above the object and continues below it, none beside it; `behindText`: Floating; no wrapping, the object is drawn behind the text; `inFrontOfText`: Floating; no wrapping, the object is drawn over the text.

WrapPolygon.description: A closed wrap polygon in a coordinate space where 21600 units span the object's width and 21600 its height (so (0, 0) is the top-left corner and (21600, 21600) the bottom-right).

edited.description: true: the polygon was edited by hand; false: it was worked out from the object.

points.description: The polygon's corners `[x, y]` in order; the last is joined back to the first. At most 1024.

WrapText.description: Which sides of a floating object text may flow on. Values: `bothSides`: Both sides; `left`: Only the left side; the band to the object's right stays empty; `right`: Only the right side; the band to the object's left stays empty; `largest`: Only whichever side has more room, decided line by line.
